asserts.name: i_peak_mA
asserts.why: THIS ONE IS MEANT TO BE HIGH. In the low-loss model the edge is limited by the pin's own 40 ohm and the bender's 32 ohm, so the spike approaches VDD/72 = 28 mA. A PASS here is the evidence that R9 is doing a job; the fitted 40 nF / 32 ohm case above shows what it reduces that spike to.
